learning_outcomes.text: Design of electrical systems and their components
Applying of design methods in representative electrical systems
Diagnosis, troubleshooting and maintenance of electrical systems and components
Elaboration and testing of an analysis program for specific electrical systems
Explanation and interpretation of software packages for design and optimization of representative electrical systems
Interpretation of results obtained with CAD software packages

syllabus_topics: Design stages. The architecture of low voltage systems.
Computation methods in low voltage electrical installation
CAD of lighting systems. DIALux software
CAD of low voltage installations. Ecodial software
Ladder language
Ladder programming
Implementation of intelligent relays
Computation of shortcircuit currents
Exemplification of shortcircuit currents.
The overcurrent protection Thermal and electrodinamic stability.
CAD for conductors dimensioning Third harmonic
Comutation equipments – protection characteristics, Protection selectivity.
Electrical shock protection – computation methods in TT, TN, IT earthing systems
Electrical efficiency in low voltage distribution systems
Project tasks. Elaboration steps
Establishing of distribution network. The layout of electrical installation
Interior lighting design – DIALux
Low voltage installation design - Ecodial software
Interpreting results in Ecodial.
Intelligent relays. Ladder diagram
Simulation of operation
teaching_methods: assisting the students in solving applications on computer

assessment_methods.method: Ability to solve a CAD application (Oral examination, Application on computer)
Solving the project tasks (Testing the project. Results interpretation)

assessment_rules: Passing the subject requires a grade of 5 or higher.
